gaps.sentence: I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
An accident held ___ the traffic for two hours.
The judge let him ___ with a warning.
gaps.explanation: let somebody off = not punish them, or give a light punishment.

gaps.sentence: The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
gaps.explanation: fall through = (a plan/deal) fail to happen.

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
The plane takes ___ in ten minutes.
gaps.explanation: take off = leave the ground (plane); also remove clothes; become successful (career took off).

gaps.sentence: Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.
